title: Particle VAE (Hard-Assigned Posterior) Fidelity & KL Identity
intuition: Hard-assignment counterpart to `model_vae_categorical`, testing whether discrete hard posterior routing still maintains reconstruction accuracy, posterior mutual information, calibrated posterior noise, and exact KL identity.
failure_mode: Hard posterior routing amplifies gradient variance and triggers dead particles or posterior collapse.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 required public-API model task (1,200 updates).
